_source: Derived from the style-guide comment + surrounding architecture comments in server/services/nlg/hospitalityKnowledge.js, server/services/nlg/templateNlgProvider.js and server/services/reasonComposer.js. No wording here is invented — traits/styles paraphrase explicit code-comment guidance; forbidden_phrases is copied verbatim.
preferred_styles: sound like a real waiter, not an AI
one consistent voice across cards, chat, and the waiter's spoken scripts (composePairingLine/upsellScript share the same narrative engine)
never leave a recommendation reason blank — always fall back to a sensible, category-aware line rather than an empty or generic one
openers/recommends/closers rotate deterministically per pairing so repeat dishes don't all read identically, without ever sounding random or inconsistent
